name: SteerNeRF
definition: A method to accelerate NeRF rendering by leveraging smooth viewpoint trajectories to reduce the number of rendered pixels and sampled points, using a low-resolution feature map rendered via volume rendering and a lightweight 2D neural renderer to recover the target resolution image.
summary: SteerNeRF accelerates NeRF rendering for interactive applications by exploiting viewpoint trajectory smoothness to reduce computational cost and memory usage.
